title: Look Closer: The Newcomer
voice: seed_audio preset: a warm, gently amused British female storyteller. Hushed and intimate, unhurried (about 140 wpm), smiling, never salesy. A small breath before each question.

cut916:
PRE-PRODUCTION (applies to both cuts): before any keyframe, generate two reference sheets with gpt_image_2_5 and attach them wherever a shot lists them. hero_sheet.png is a photoreal studio turnaround on plain light grey (front sitting, left and right profile, back, face close-up) of the hero cat exactly as written in shots 7 and 8: a young, slim silver-grey classic tabby with a white blaze into a white muzzle, a white bib, four white socks, amber-gold eyes, a charcoal-tipped ringed tail and no collar. cottage_sheet.png is a photoreal live-action build of the cottage from hd_front.png and hd_q34.png (real terracotta, lime plaster and oak), in front and three-quarter views. Generate shot 7 START first and save it as ad/keyframes/shot07_start.png, because shot 9 is built from it.

9:16 CUT (1080x1920): same 38 s, same shot order, VO, music and text timings.
1) Native vertical keyframes: regenerate shots 1, 2 (start+end), 3, 7 (start+end), 8, 9 and 10 (start+end) at 9:16 with the same prompts and references.
- Shot 1: the iris circle at 60% of frame width, dead centre, with shot 2's window on the same circle so the match cut holds.
- Shot 2: the end frame is the cottage front and porch filling the tall frame.
- Shot 3: the cottage and path stacked vertically, with the hero on the wall at lower right.
- Shots 7 and 9: the sun in the upper half and the cat on the wall in the lower-middle. Shot 9 is still built from shot 7 START.
- Shot 8: the round window at the top and the curled hero in the lower-middle.
- Shot 10: ends with clear sky in the top 30%.
2) Reframe shots 4, 5 and 6 from the 16:9 masters with Higgsfield reframe/outpaint, centred on the action. Shot 4 centres on the paw and lily pad. Shot 5 puts the tabby's face in the upper half and slides the card up into the lower-middle. Shot 6 centres on the fountain and statue.
3) Text placement:
- All supers, the card and captions sit inside a centred 1080x1420 safe area (250 px clear at top and bottom), with no text in the right-hand 140 px where the platform buttons sit.
- Burn in the VO as captions of two lines or fewer in the lower-middle for sound-off feeds.
- 'Look closer.' is large on frame 1.
4) End card:
- The wordmark sits in the top third. 'A free 3D cat garden to explore.', catcoinsanctuary.com and 'New cats every hour on X · @catcosanctuary' sit in the middle.
- The legal line sits just above the bottom UI zone, at a legible size, for the full 4.2 s.
- The real-site dissolve uses a portrait (mobile-viewport) capture of the live site, cleared the same way as the 16:9 capture.
5) Loop: the end-card plate has the cottage's round window centred on the same circle guide as frame 1's eye, so a replay reads window to eye without a jolt.

DISTRIBUTION (both cuts): the landing page shows coin cards and buy links, so treat any paid placement as a crypto ad.
- Paid placement needs crypto-advertiser authorization on Meta, Google and X, 18+ targeting and per-market risk warnings (UK: an FCA-approved promotion with the prescribed risk warning; EU: MiCA marketing rules).
- No paid TikTok. Organic posting is fine.
- Get compliance sign-off before any paid use.
